quest.title: Zhongli's Treat
quest.description: That Bubu Pharmacy trip turned into quite an exhilarating ride. (Okay, maybe not that exhilarating.) In yet another remarkable twist, Zhongli has offered to treat you to dinner!
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x575, Primogem x30, Mora x19800, Memory of Immovable Crystals x1, Adventurer's Experience x7, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here. There's no need to order, I've already done so.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: "Third-Round Knockout" is not for lightweights, like those taverns in Mondstadt. Here, the owner does not take such unorthodox orders as fruit juice.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, does this mean I can order wine this time?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I ordered some wine-fermented sweet rice balls for you, if that counts.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I guess I should have expected this...

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: ...If it is to your liking, dear customers, I shall continue the tale of Lady Ningguang's Jade Chamber.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, there's even a storyteller here! Great atmosphere!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Besides fine wine, the excellent ambience is the reason why this place is so well-loved.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: But when I say ambience, I refer to a different sort from the one the Teyvat Travel Guide uses to judge other establishments.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: As you all know, high above the land of Liyue lies a pavilion in the clouds, a palace in the mist...

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: What does it mean to have all-seeing eyes? This, my friends: Lady Ningguang's masterwork that bridges earth and sky.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: Imagine. The weather is clear, and you gaze down from the deck on the world below...

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: Behold! The glorious sights of Liyue Harbor, stretching out far and wide!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: These are but scraps of paper, and yet they guide Lady Ningguang's hand — such is their value.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: Merely grasping one or two of them will surely gift you a fragment of her wisdom — enough to stay a step or two ahead of your peers.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tianquan Ningguang... feels like we're hearing this name a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Liyue locals talk about her, the Fatui hate her, she's most likely the one who hid the Exuvia, and we saw her at the Rite of Descension...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, Paimon wonders what sort of person she is.
At last, I have found you, you who returned from Jueyun Karst.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who's there!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, we gotta go... !
Wait! I am not with the Millelith, nor am I here to claim your bounty.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: However, I am an emissary of the Liyue Qixing. My name is Ganyu, secretary at the Yuehai Pavilion, and I have come specifically to meet you.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Well, in concrete terms, I am the corporate secretary for the Qixing. At the moment, I am serving as Lady Ningguang's special emissary.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ningguang sent you? We were literally just talking about her...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: My apologies, you who have returned from Jueyun Karst... I am duty-bound, and cannot extend my courtesy to you in full.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: But I have with me a letter from Lady Ningguang. She extends a formal invitation to you in her capacity as Tianquan.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: She invites you to her palace in the sky.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: "At the Jade Chamber, together, we shall snip every one of these entwining dark threads."

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Ningguang... Ganyu...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I wonder where we will find them amid these dark tides?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And with that, the emissary who called herself Ganyu just disappeared...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But we've received an invitation from the Liyue Qixing. Paimon still can't believe it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! We'll be meeting people that have way more money than Paimon could ever count... We should be on our best manners!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Hah... An invitation to visit the Jade Chamber is a rare honor, indeed.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: You'd best be on your way now. But don't forget about the Rite of Parting. Once you've finished at the Jade Chamber, meet me at Dihua Marsh.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, we won't forget! Dihua Marsh. We'll see you there!

choices.text: Paimon is up to something again...
